role: Senior dbt Analytics Engineer – PySpark & Apache Iceberg – Brussels
responsibilities: Design, develop and maintain scalable data transformation pipelines using dbt and PySpark;
Optimize dbt project performance, SQL transformations and incremental data processing;
Develop and maintain data quality checks, automated regression tests and pipeline validation procedures;
Design modular dbt models using staging, intermediate and marts layers, reusable macros and established analytics engineering practices;
Work with Apache Iceberg tables, including schema evolution, partition evolution and snapshot management;
Translate business requirements and legacy processing logic into reliable, production-ready data transformations;
Support migration and reconciliation activities, ensuring functional equivalence between legacy and modern data pipelines;
Establish dbt development best practices, maintain technical documentation and collaborate with data engineering and business teams.
